When a mcount pointer is recorded into a table
column2: it is used to add or

column1: remove calls to mcount (replacing them with nops). If the code is removed

column2: the pointers still exist.  At modifying the code

column1: a check is always made to make sure the code being replaced is the code

column2: the code being replaced is compared to what

column1: it is expected to be before being replaced.
There is a very small chance that the code being replaced just happens
to look like code that calls mcount (very small since the call to mcount
is relative). To remove this chance
allow module unloading to remove the pointers to mcount within the module.
Another change for init calls is made to not trace calls marked with
__init. The tracing can not be started until after init is done anyway.
